Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. We’re in the final stages of our vendor assurance review for Q3 and noticed Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report has an audit period ending 2027-03-31. For our compliance pack we need confirmation of coverage through today (or until a specified date) for the security and availability categories.

Specifically, can Redwood provide:

- Any control-evidence artifacts or a checklist indicating where changes were made (if applicable);
- The standard signature path (DocuSign or signed PDF) and an anticipated turnaround time.

Do you also accept the SIG Lite form? Our procurement team will likely request it.

Target due date from our side: Jul 28, 2027. Please let me know the next steps and any blockers.

Thanks,

Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the note and for the clear timeline. We can support a bridge letter confirming coverage from Apr 1, 2027 through Jul 20, 2027 outlining that no material changes occurred affecting the scope of our SOC 2 Type II report. To expedite, a few clarifications would help: 

1) Scope: You asked for security and availability 9—do you require any additional trust services (confidentiality/processing integrity) to be called out?
2) Evidence: Are you looking for control-level artifacts (for example, change logs, incident summaries, or configuration snapshots) or a high-level statement that controls remained materially consistent?
3) Legal/Signature: Will a DocuSign-signed PDF suffice, or do you need an executed paper original?

I'm attaching our SOC 2 report (SOC2_Report_Redwood_20270331.pdf) and an internal control matrix that maps changes in Q2/Q3 2027 (control-matrix-q2q3-2027.xlsx) so you can see the level of detail we can provide.

Laura (legal) and Karthik (info sec) are looped in to confirm the bridge-letter wording and any legal disclaimers. If you can confirm the exact evidence types you need (and who from procurement will sign), we'll draft the bridge letter and return it for signature within 3-5 business days.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
